item.description: A review Item that carries evidence or criterion links is refused with the cover command to use; an implementation Item may not carry a review record.
item.label: No evidence in a review request

item.description: cover --changed-lines keeps working unchanged: it writes flat 40-e records keyed by the review Item's URN against the review's range.
item.label: cover writes coverage

item.description: For review decks only, the loader attaches flat coverage records to the current transaction Items, so coverage survives slide revisions and diagram edits.
item.label: Loader attaches coverage

item.description: apply-slide refuses a revision that drops or renames a review Item which still has coverage records (naming remove-coverage) or an append-only review comment on it.
item.label: Nothing left pointing at nothing

item.description: A hand-written review slide's migrated root revision carries no evidence, because its cover records keep attaching to the same Item URNs.
item.label: Migration keeps coverage

slide.takeaway: A review request carries no evidence; cover writes coverage keyed by the Item URN, and the loader attaches it to transaction Items across revisions.
slide.title: Review Items keep cover as their one source of code
